steps.input:
def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    base = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0] != base]
    cols = [j for j in range(w) if Counter(grid[i][j] for i in range(h)).most_common(1)[0][0] != base]
    line_values = Counter(grid[i][j] for i in rows for j in range(w))
    line_values.update(grid[i][j] for j in cols for i in range(h))
    line_values.pop(base, None)
    line_color = line_values.most_common(1)[0][0]
    lattice = [[grid[i][j] for j in cols] for i in rows]
    blocks = []
    for i in range(len(rows)-1):
        for j in range(len(cols)-1):
            color = lattice[i][j]
            if color in (base, line_color):
                continue
            if all(lattice[di][dj] == color for di,dj in ((i,j+1),(i+1,j),(i+1,j+1))):
                blocks.append((i,j,color))
    r0=min(i for i,j,c in blocks); r1=max(i for i,j,c in blocks)
    c0=min(j for i,j,c in blocks); c1=max(j for i,j,c in blocks)
    out=[[base for _ in range(c1-c0+1)] for _ in range(r1-r0+1)]
    for i,j,c in blocks: out[i-r0][j-c0]=c
    return out

program='''from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    base = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    separator_rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0] != base]
    separator_cols = [j for j in range(w) if Counter(grid[i][j] for i in range(h)).most_common(1)[0][0] != base]

    line_colors = Counter(grid[i][j] for i in separator_rows for j in range(w))
    line_colors.update(grid[i][j] for j in separator_cols for i in range(h))
    line_colors.pop(base, None)
    separator_color = line_colors.most_common(1)[0][0]
    lattice = [[grid[i][j] for j in separator_cols] for i in separator_rows]

    blocks = []
    for i in range(len(lattice) - 1):
        for j in range(len(lattice[0]) - 1):
            color = lattice[i][j]
            if color in (base, separator_color):
                continue
            if (lattice[i][j + 1] == color and
                    lattice[i + 1][j] == color and
                    lattice[i + 1][j + 1] == color):
                blocks.append((i, j, color))

    min_row = min(i for i, _, _ in blocks)
    max_row = max(i for i, _, _ in blocks)
    min_col = min(j for _, j, _ in blocks)
    max_col = max(j for _, j, _ in blocks)
    output = [[base for _ in range(max_col - min_col + 1)]
              for _ in range(max_row - min_row + 1)]
    for i, j, color in blocks:
        output[i - min_row][j - min_col] = color
    return output
'''
